design.name: Course level (root)

metadata.Target Audience: Undergraduate students who finished basic programming courses but new to AI.

design.Goal: Define the overall course information, including the course description and the full syllabus.
design.guideline: The course level must define shared metadata, a comprehensive course description including key learning objectives, and a syllabus detailing the number of lectures and their respective topics.

design.name: Lecture level (subdirectory)
design.Goal: Define lecture-specific descriptions and the outline of slides to be created for that lecture.
design.guideline: Each lecture must include metadata (number and title), a description of key points to cover, and an outline of 20 to 40 slides; this quantitative constraint must be strictly followed.

design.name: Slide level (files)
design.Goal: Define the abstract for each slide (including layout and animation) and generate the actual HTML content.
design.guideline: Select from three specific layouts: two-column animated (default), two-column code (for code-only slides), or three-column interactive quiz (for review/concept checks). Generate HTML content based on the abstract following detailed templates.
